title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #18 (PolishBoleslawiec+RussianPalekh+RomanianHorezu+KoreanEunipsa / VasarelyOpArt+UkrainianPysanka+TurkishIznik+CubistFragment / HungarianKalocsa+NigerianAdire+JapaneseMakie+KlimtMosaic)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Indian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bold and confident, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long oval nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands, dense peacock-eye dot motifs) dominates one zone. Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands, dense jewel-toned scenework) dominates the second zone. Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands, dense spiral floral bands) dominates the third zone. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, cool and composed, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates one zone. Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands, dense geometric wax-resist linework) dominates the second zone. Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands, dense floral scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands, dense angular fragment planes) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, cheerful, cool ash-grey hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands, dense folk-art floral motifs) dominates one zone. Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, wide white bands, dense spiral resist motifs) dominates the second zone. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates the third zone. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto corset-lace boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
